name: BikeWorld 🏍️
desc:
Welcome to BikeWorld, the #1 Bike Experience on Roblox! ✨

🎨 Customize your bike – from paint jobs to performance parts!
🏁 Race your friends & pop wheelies – show off your skills
💸 Buy, trade, and upgrade – unlock new bikes and trade your builds
🧰 Tune Everything - Cylinder, Carburetor, Exhaust, Air Filter, Gearing, Ignition, Crankpin – it’s all in your hands! 🙌

👍 LIKE THE GAME FOR MORE UPDATES!

PC CONTROLS💻
🛵 Wheelie - L-Shift 📷 Freecam - L-Shift + P

MONEY BONUSES💸:
+10% - JOIN GROUP
+20% - PREMIUM PLAYERS
+50% - VIP GAMEPASS

🚨 WARNING | Game is in early beta, bugs should be expected!
